a1.label: 1. Lena spends two days per week...
a1.why: The text says Lena spends two days in class at vocational school.

a2.label: 2. Her main responsibility at work is...
a2.why: The text says Lena's main responsibility is first-level support.

a3.label: 3. Tobias gives Lena feedback...
a3.why: The text says her mentor Tobias gives feedback every Friday.

a4.label: 4. During the probation period...
a4.why: The text says both the company and Lena checked whether it was a good fit.

a5.label: 5. Lena is now preparing for...
a5.why: The text says Lena is now preparing for her intermediate exam.

a6.label: 6. Her advice to new apprentices?
a6.why: The text says Lena's advice is to ask questions.

b1.label: 1. A dual ___ combines work and school
b1.why: A ‘dual apprenticeship’ combines practical work with vocational school.

b2.label: 2. An experienced colleague who guides you
b2.why: A ‘mentor’ is an experienced colleague who guides and supports you.

b3.label: 3. The first months of employment
b3.why: The first months of employment are usually a probation period.

b4.label: 4. Constructive ___ helps you improve
b4.why: Constructive feedback helps you understand what you can improve.

b5.label: 5. Keeping the ticket system updated is part of my ___
b5.why: This task is part of the trainee's job responsibility.

b6.label: 6. Both sides sign an employment ___
b6.why: Both sides sign an employment contract before starting.

b7.label: 7. Attending workshops is part of your ___
b7.why: Attending workshops and getting certificates is part of professional development.

c1.label: 1. An apprentice is someone ___ learns...
c1.why: ‘Who’ introduces a relative clause about a person.

c2.label: 2. A mentor is a person ___ experience helps...

c3.label: 3. A service desk is the place ___ requests arrive
c3.why: ‘Where’ introduces a relative clause about a place.

c4.label: 4. A ticket is a record ___ describes...
c4.why: ‘That’ introduces a defining relative clause about a thing (a record).

c5.label: 5. Probation is the period ___ performance is reviewed
c5.why: ‘When’ introduces a relative clause about a time period.

c6.label: 6. A trainee ___ asks good questions...
c6.why: ‘Who’ introduces a relative clause about a person.

c7.label: 7. The report ___ Lena wrote...
c7.why: ‘Which’ introduces a defining relative clause about a thing (the report).
